DRAG / ARROWS TO ORBIT · SCROLL TO ZOOM · SPACE CHANGES SURFACE

The mathematics

Schwarz’s polyhedron, or Schwarz lantern, stacks staggered polygon rings on a cylinder. The controls set n vertices per ring and m bands; there are 2mn triangular faces. The live area ratio compares their summed area with the cylinder’s lateral area 2πrH, excluding end caps. More bands can increase error even though the vertices lie on the cylinder. When both counts grow, convergence requires m/n² to tend to zero. Space cycles solid, wireframe, and glass views.
